'''AV-6R7''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[V-series droid supervisor/Legends|V-series droid supervisor]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. The [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] oversaw work [[Droid/Legends|droids]] building the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and was serving in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], with the ''Executor'' colliding with the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the course of the battle.

==Biography==
[[File:AV-6R7.png|thumb|250px|AV-6R7 (left) on the ''Executor'']]
Manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]],<ref name="TNEGtD" /> AV-6R7 was a [[V-series droid supervisor/Legends|V-series droid supervisor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="VD" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] served the Empire's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] by overseeing work [[Droid/Legends|droids]] building the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]],<ref name="VD" /> which was in construction over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> At one point, AV-6R7 was deprived of [[Limb/Legends|arms]] for failing to keep track of a faulty [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]].<ref name="VD" />

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> AV-6R7&mdash;both arms intact&mdash;was aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Endor. When the ''Executor'' questioned the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']], which requested to land on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], AV-6R7 was present aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] crew pits as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] allowed the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to pass. Not long after, AV-6R7 was still aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge during the early stages of the Empire's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. As the battle progressed, the ''Executor'' collided with the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] and was destroyed.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Characteristics==
AV-6R7 had a [[Logic and Processing Unit|logic processor]] and an augmented monitor system on the head, with a monitor power hookup extending from the neck to the head. The droid had [[Color/Legends|black]] polished [[Plastron/Legends|plastron]] plating.<ref name="VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
AV-6R7 first appeared in [[1983]]'s {{Film|VI}}, the third film in the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The droid's scenes were filmed on [[February 8]], [[1982]] on [[Elstree Studios]]'s Stage 1.<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In [[1998]], AV-6R7 was first named in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="VD" />
